description: An awareness episode of about 15 minutes for all staff. On an authorised exercise at Quayholt Insurance, a fictional insurer, during a leaver's last week, you first make this week's ordinary calls, then see where each led. Then you sort a short set of messages and learn to raise a concern as facts, not a verdict. Only the set is scored, reporting when you're unsure is always fine and never marked down, and you are never asked to investigate anyone.
